problem_title: Recurring Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road — Shanthi Nagar (2019–2021)
problem_summary: 7 citizen complaints about 'Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road' were recorded in Shanthi Nagar between March 2019 and November 2021, spanning 3 calendar year(s). 29% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened). 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after initially being resolved.
representative_subcategory: Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 24 pothole complaints.
22 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹34.8 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (exact_name join).
Ward recorded 85 road crashes in 2024, of which 12 were fatal.

hypotheses: HYPOTHESIS (unverified): 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after being marked resolved. This may indicate short-term or superficial repairs that did not address the underlying problem.
agency_attribution_note: 7 of 7 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.43). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, crash_risk=0.85, unresolved_rate=0.29.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Shanthi Nagar' matched to datameet243=182 via exact_name (overlap_confidence=0.856).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Shanthi Nagar for the period 2019–2021.
Request inspection records for the 22 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Investigate the 1 re-opened complaint(s) to determine whether patchwork repairs were applied and failed.
Cross-reference crash location data with cluster centroid to assess whether road condition may be a contributing factor to road accidents.
